Reviewed `dedupe-imports` against `main` at `62644c3`. **One merge-blocking finding:**

**[P1] Overlapping contacts aren’t deduped by ID — `src/dedupe.js:2`**
`new Set(contacts)` compares objects by reference, not by `id`. Separate imports produce separate objects, so the same contact survives multiple times, contrary to the README’s “one contact per id, keeping the first seen” contract. This also breaks `mergeImports`.

Reproduced with:
```js
mergeImports(
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }],
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }]
)
// Actual: both contacts
// Expected: only the first contact
```

Track seen IDs while preserving input order. Add regression tests using distinct objects with the same ID, both directly through `dedupe` and across lists through `mergeImports`. The current duplicate test only repeats the same object reference, masking the bug.

**Validation:** All 4 existing tests pass; the same-ID reproduction fails for both functions. No files changed.
